body:
This is not a bug, but a quirk of 2D positional audio. This is because positional audio is relative to the camera bounds, and changing the window size will alter the camera bounds. You will notice the same issue if you resize the window.

The issue disappears if you add a Camera2D node (with no properties changed), since Camera2D ensures the game viewport is centered correctly regardless of window size. You can also use AudioStreamPlayer instead of AudioStreamPlayer2D for non-positional audio. See also https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/discussions/9719.

This does not occur in 3D because what you see in 3D doesn't depend on the window size (unless its aspect ratio changes, but I don't think Godot's 3D audio attenuation takes it into account).
